lines.text: Many learners say: I want to be doctor.
Better: I want to be a doctor.
A! My mother is a nurse.

data.right: I want to be a doctor.

native.tip: 직업 앞에는 a나 an을 붙여요. “I want to be a doctor”예요.
native.caption: “I want to be doctor”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 직업을 말할 때는 셀 수 있는 명사라서 앞에 a나 an을 붙여요. “I want to be a doctor”가 맞아요. Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “a”. 직업 앞에는 a! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: Put a before a job. Say “I want to be a doctor”.
en.caption: Do you say “I want to be doctor”? 😅 A job is a countable noun, so it needs “a” or “an”. “I want to be a doctor” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
